section: Iterate - bug: release changelog event before the merge
title: Record the release changelog event in the release PR
context: The changelog skill recorded its event after the merge into the main checkout, where nothing committed it; main stayed dirty and the event never reached history.
decision: Record, commit (explicit pathspec) and push the event before merging the release PR; on main, before the single tag push.
consequences: The event arrives with the release; the post-merge phase-complete writers (dashboard, handoff, run-config) are unchanged and remain a separate concern.
rationale: The event is part of the release and belongs in its PR, like the changelog entry itself.
rejected: Committing the event to main after the merge (extra direct push to main, races other merges).
